observations.content:
Summary: Jensen Huang is the co-founder, president, and CEO of NVIDIA, a position he has held since the company's inception in 1993. As of September 2026, Forbes estimates his net worth at over US$190 billion, making him the eighth-wealthiest individual in the world. Huang holds a BSEE degree from Oregon State University and an MSEE degree from Stanford University. He has been recognized with numerous awards, including being named Fortune’s Businessperson of the Year in 2017 and being ranked No. 1 on Harvard Business Review’s list of the world’s most influential business leaders in 2019.
